title: Swift 20-Minute Budget Review
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to focus exclusively on reviewing the proposed 1987-88 City Budget.
*   The session was remarkably brief, concluding in just 20 minutes.
*   Mayor Cooksey led the discussion, despite three council members being absent.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - November 04, 1987 - 2:30 P.M.
Council Chambers. 307 West Second Street, Austin. Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order Che special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence of
Councilmembers Urdy, Humphrey and Shipman.
The purpose of the meeting was to review the 1987-88 Budget.
Council adjourned its special called meeting at 2:50 p.m.
